many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

a=[list(map(int,l.split())) for l in grid.splitlines()]; R=len(a);C=len(a[0]);seen=set(); comps=[]
for r in range(R):
 for c in range(C):
  if a[r][c]==0 and (r,c) not in seen:
   st=[(r,c)];seen.add((r,c));co=[]
   while st:
    x,y=st.pop();co.append((x,y))
    for dx in (-1,0,1):
     for dy in (-1,0,1):
      q=(x+dx,y+dy)
      if 0<=q[0]<R and 0<=q[1]<C and a[q[0]][q[1]]==0 and q not in seen:seen.add(q);st.append(q)
   comps.append(co)
print(sorted([len(x) for x in comps],reverse=True)); print([[(r+1,c+1) for r,c in x] for x in comps if len(x)>1])
